title: Common
description: Shared definitions (PLAN §3.3). Each kind schema keeps its own copy under $defs so pg_jsonschema can check it without resolving other files; tests/contracts.test.mjs fails if a copy drifts from this file. The URL pattern is only the first gate: src/lib/content/url.ts (and the M2 publish RPC) also reject IP-literal hosts, punycode and non-default ports.
